# BrightChamps

> Interactive online learning platform offering expert-led courses in coding, robotics, AI, math, science, and financial literacy for kids globally.

BrightChamps provides comprehensive STEM and life skills education through interactive online classes, self-paced DIY courses, and competitive hackathons. The platform serves students across multiple countries with courses in programming languages like Python, C++, and Scratch, robotics kits, and financial literacy training.

## Key Topics

- Online coding classes
- Robotics education
- Generative AI
- Financial literacy
- STEM learning
- Python programming
- Interactive lessons
- Self-paced learning
- Kids education
- Math classes
- Science classes
- Hackathon competitions
- SAT prep
- Communication skills
- DIY projects

## Core Learning Courses

- [Online Coding Classes for Kids in United States](https://brightchamps.com/en-us/courses/coding-classes-for-kids): Expert-led online coding classes for kids in Scratch, Python, Java & C++
- [Online Robotics Classes for Kids in United States](https://brightchamps.com/en-us/courses/robotics-classes-for-kids): Online robotics classes using RoboPrime, RoboXcel & other robotics kits for kids
- [Online AI Courses for Kids in United States](https://brightchamps.com/en-us/courses/gen-ai-for-kids): Online AI courses for kids covering Generative AI, Python and AI fundamentals
- [Online Math Classes for Kids in United States](https://brightchamps.com/en-us/courses/math-classes-for-kids): Online math classes for kids with adaptive learning and CCSS/NCTM alignment
- [Online Science Classes for Kids in United States](https://brightchamps.com/en-us/courses/science-classes-for-kids): Online science classes for kids with hands-on experiments and STEM foundations
- [Online English Classes for Kids in United States](https://brightchamps.com/en-us/courses/communication-classes-for-kids): Online English and public speaking classes for kids with communication skills training

## Specialized Programs

- [Online Financial Literacy Course for Kids in United States](https://brightchamps.com/en-us/courses/financial-literacy-classes-for-kids): Online financial literacy course for kids with money management & stock market skills
- [Online SAT Prep Courses for Kids in United States](https://brightchamps.com/en-us/courses/sat-classes-for-kids): Online SAT prep courses with reading, writing and math exam preparation for kids
- [Global Hackathon 2026 USA | Online Hackathon Competition](https://brightchamps.com/en-us/courses/hackathon): Global Hackathon 2026 USA competition for students with AI, coding & finance projects

## DIY & Self-Paced Classes

- [Fun DIY Classes for Students in United States](https://brightchamps.com/en-us/courses/diy-classes-for-kids): DIY classes catalog with creative projects, Rubik's Cube, Vedic Maths and AI courses
- [Gen AI](https://brightchamps.com/en-us/courses/diy-classes-for-kids/gen-ai): Creative AI tools workshop for kids 8-14 with prompt engineering and AI ethics
- [Vedic Maths](https://brightchamps.com/en-us/courses/diy-classes-for-kids/vedic-maths): Self-paced Vedic Maths course for kids with fast calculation and mental math techniques
- [Rubik's Cube](https://brightchamps.com/en-us/courses/diy-classes-for-kids/rubiks-cube): Self-paced Rubik's Cube mastery class for kids 8-14 with spatial reasoning skills
- [Become a YouTuber](https://brightchamps.com/en-us/courses/diy-classes-for-kids/become-a-youtuber): Video creation class for kids to build confident online presence and YouTube skills
- [Smart Investing](https://brightchamps.com/en-us/courses/diy-classes-for-kids/smart-investing): Self-paced financial literacy class on money, banking and investing for kids 8-14
- [Smart Borrowing](https://brightchamps.com/en-us/courses/diy-classes-for-kids/smart-borrowing): Debt management and credit comparison workshop for teens with financial literacy focus
- [Anti-Bullying](https://brightchamps.com/en-us/courses/diy-classes-for-kids/anti-bullying): Anti-bullying and empathy building workshop for kids 8-14 with social-emotional learning
